summary: Contact-info bug-fix verification (iteration 3). Verified all site-wide new business contact info (phone (346) 621-1342, main (346) 646-3386, fax (346) 601-3640, email contact@careflexsupplies.com) is present, and all old values ('346-636-0201', '#800', '(713) 800-5088', 'care@careflex.com') are absent across home, contact, providers, insurance, faq, intake, cart pages plus index.html meta/JSON-LD. Backend GET /api/faqs and GET /api/posts/medicare-dme-coverage-guide confirmed clean via curl. NOTE: Initial page load served stale index.html (old phone in meta + JSON-LD). A frontend supervisor restart cleared the cache and the served HTML now matches the file on disk.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend dev server was serving cached index.html with old contact info until manual `supervisorctl restart frontend`. If main agent edits public/index.html, remember to restart frontend so users see the new head/meta/JSON-LD.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All contact info updated everywhere. testids validated: topbar-phone, call-now-button, footer-phone, footer-main-phone, footer-fax, contact-phone, contact-main-phone, contact-email, faq-question-2. index.html JSON-LD MedicalBusiness telephone/fax/email correct. If page HTML shows old values, first restart frontend (public/index.html cache) before reporting.
rca of the issue: Root cause of any stale contact info seen after fix: /app/frontend/public/index.html is loaded by CRA dev server at server startup and cached in memory; edits require frontend restart. Reproduction: curl the site root after editing index.html — old meta persists. Mitigation: `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`. Verified after restart the served HTML contains +1-346-621-1342 (JSON-LD) and (346) 621-1342 (meta description).
